scope: Bind S5L boot/heartbeat elapsed clocks to their selected VM clock, retain target clock identity and one common capture/publication epoch including incoming retired-clock restoration; preserve existing wall and explicit synthetic timer profiles. Full four findings/default idle/RTC/native/replay remain open.

assumptions.assumption: An elapsed clock retains the mode/identity selected when its owner is constructed; foreign ambient contexts do not change it.
assumptions.basis: Existing TimingContext and LAPIC clock ownership contract; VMM now selects before CPU/device construction.
assumptions.dependent_result: Host-independent S5L elapsed timing in Retired mode and preserved standalone Wall behavior.
assumptions.stress_test: Host delay, foreign timing scopes, counter wrap and explicit det_timer=0 guest counter path.
assumptions.falsification_probe: A selected elapsed value changes with host delay or reads another VM clock.

assumptions.assumption: Every restored elapsed clock starts from the incoming logical epoch, not the target old epoch before clock.commit.
assumptions.basis: Checkpoint restore commits CPU permits before the clock token; all source CPUs need one capture and activation point.
assumptions.dependent_result: Exact pre-entry and1/2/4 prepared-context file continuation without epoch double counting.
assumptions.stress_test: Source/target clock epochs differ, delayed preparation, snapshot before first restored entry, all shared elapsed fields.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Restoring twice adds source elapsed time, target old epoch or preparation time.

assumptions.assumption: Stopped-clock writers remain quiescent through checkpoint publication, as required by the existing VM snapshot contract.
assumptions.basis: VMM exclusive CPU vector and documented independent-writer contract; publication commit cannot acquire new clock locks.
assumptions.dependent_result: Precomputed incoming retired epoch can publish without locks/allocations; wall publication samples its existing host boundary.
assumptions.stress_test: Inspect lock order; explicit publication/capture tests and final admission failures.
assumptions.falsification_probe: A legitimate concurrent clock writer can change the stopped VM timeline during publication without caller coordination.

assumptions.assumption: Existing synthetic det_timer and timer scaling are explicit guest-affecting profiles and retain their defined behavior.
assumptions.basis: S5L profile/configuration and prior checkpoint qualification; this group fixes the elapsed-clock branch rather than redefining every device rate.
assumptions.dependent_result: No silent profile migration or new counter/wire layout.
assumptions.stress_test: det_timer positive and zero, full u64 multipliers, existing wall and private-image compatibility tests.
assumptions.falsification_probe: An unchanged profile produces different counter arithmetic beyond the selected elapsed time source.

change_surface.clock_source: runtime-only owned clock epochs; no serialized pointer/source identity
change_surface.S5L: elapsed capture,reset,target rebinding and shared publication; unchanged device/profile wire values
change_surface.checkpoint: source epoch sampled once; incoming virtual publication point prepared before CPU activation
change_surface.limits: S5L PMU RTC, other board clocks, default/idle model, native retirement and full replay remain open

baseline.actual_parent_behavior: Two selected retired-clock tests fail because prior S5L elapsed anchors observe host delay.

limits.item: Clock writers remain quiescent through stopped-VM publication; external independent writers require caller coordination.
Default clock remains Wall; logical idle advance, RTC/timezone/entropy capture, other board clock consumers and full replay remain incomplete.
Prepared online 1/2/4 CPU contexts do not establish architectural secondary startup; native deterministic retirement and physical Intel HVF validation remain open.
Wrapping elapsed observations require gaps shorter than 2^64 ns; elapsed Duration addition saturates, existing u64 timer scale multiplication wraps.

workflow: Direct master; exact-path git add and red -m --staged --run; no push/new branch/worktree; remove only idle owned canonical C/T after commit

time_arithmetic.precision: Integer nanoseconds and retained VM thirds; guest elapsed timer truncates to microseconds; no physical frequency claim.

requirements.behavior: Selected elapsed clock excludes host/foreign time and retains owner through reset.
Elapsed private image remains source independent; suspended replacement rebinds to target and foreign publication denies before mutation.
Common publication uses incoming retired epoch before clock token commit; pre-entry capture does not double count.
Actual source-free1/2/4 CPU files preserve selected guest timer reads and counts under conflicting destination settings.
Preserve wall arithmetic, serialized elapsed fields and synthetic/scaling profiles.
Exact owned commit on master, preserve unrelated state and remove idle owned roots.
